Nina Patel: Quick sync: QuiverHealth dedicated rollout moved to Wed 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC. Quiet window 02:30-04:00. Need final pin + QA signoff. Suggested pins: runtime v1.12.4, model quiver-rl-2026-03@sha256:7a9c.
Marta Gonzalez: Product here 1: release notes pushed: https://redwood.in/release/quiver-2026-04-01 1. Flags documented under 'feature_toggles' and 'data_isolation'.
Samir Choi: SRE: staging smoke started. KMS rotation for Quiver is on 2026-04-02 so no conflict.
Jules: Please paste deploybot invocation so I can confirm canary sequencing and health checks.
deploybot: deploybot: job created
```
deploy run --customer=quiverhealth --env=dedicated --runtime=v1.12.4 --model=quiver-rl-2026-03@sha256:7a9c --canary=10,50 --quiet=02:30-04:00 --rollback-ttl=30m
```
Theo Lang: Ops requirements: auto-rollback if error rate >1.5% OR p95 latency >800ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows. Also alert on kv_cache_miss >3x baseline. Capture these in the deploy config.
Nina Patel: noted, will attach to ticket and annotate deploybot.
Marta Gonzalez: Product decision: feature flags default OFF for Quiver tenant during rollout; they will toggle post-validation.
Samir Choi: Staging looks clean. Observed ~5% GPU mem variance with bundle, within margin. Will monitor during canary.
Jules: I'll run evaluation harness at canary start and post diffs (fuzzy match + scalar metrics) within 10m.
Nina Patel: Final approvals needed: @Samir @Theo @Marta
Samir Choi: +1 SRE. Smoke passed.
Theo Lang: +1 Ops.
Marta Gonzalez: +1 Product.
deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled 1 1 will kick at 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z and stream status here. Dry-run passed (checks: canary ranges, healthchecks, rollback rules). :rocket:
Jules: On-call for validation. If A/B drift on eval >3% we hold and escalate.
Nina Patel: Thanks team. I'll update the rollout ticket and leave this thread pinned to the release. If anything shifts, please reply here. :)
